claims.claim: Ambient proxies are disabled and a literal-loopback authenticated mint request cannot be intercepted by configured proxy state.
Cross-authority redirects are rejected before any target connection or bearer disclosure.
Response bodies accept exactly 8192 cumulative chunked bytes and reject 8193 bytes or oversized Content-Length with stable typed errors.
Exactly one case-sensitive Authorization bearer is sent and access tokens plus minted tickets remain absent from Debug and Display output.
The production clock sample occurs after response receipt while private fixed-time tests prove expired, exact-max-TTL, and excessive-TTL boundaries without adding retries.
